body: Justin Herbert is the subject of conflicting trade rumors involving the Minnesota Vikings and Cleveland Browns, with the Los Angeles Chargers explicitly denying any talks with the Vikings. While Yahoo Sports, CBS Sports, and Sports Illustrated discuss potential landing spots and capital requirements for a blockbuster deal, Gridiron Heroics reports the Browns are linked to such a trade, whereas NDTV Sports states the Chargers have shut down discussions with the Vikings.

findings.evidence_quote: Los Angeles Chargers Shut Down Justin Herbert Trade Talk With Minnesota Vikings
Browns Linked To Blockbuster Justin Herbert Trade With Chargers
